tools.name: validate_email
tools.description: Validate a single email address in sub-80ms with zero SMTP probing: checks RFC-5322 syntax & punycode, live DNS-over-HTTPS MX/SPF/DMARC records, mail provider classification (Google Workspace, Microsoft 365, Proofpoint, Mimecast), 121,900+ disposable/burner domains, role-based inboxes, Levenshtein t

tools.name: validate_emails_bulk
tools.description: Validate up to 100 email addresses in a single high-speed batch with parallel domain DNS/RDAP deduplication. Returns batch summary metrics (valid, invalid, disposable, risky_role, corporate_count, avg_quality_score) plus full per-email verdicts. Cost: 2 Credits / email validated.

tools.name: check_disposable_and_role_email
tools.description: Ultra-fast sub-10ms filter checking an email or domain against 121,900+ disposable/burner email domains, wildcard traps, role-based inboxes (admin@, support@, noreply@, billing@), free webmail vs corporate domain classification, and common typo suggestions. Cost: 1 Credit / call.

tools.name: audit_domain_deliverability
tools.description: Run a complete outbound & inbound email authentication audit for any domain: MX records & mail provider, SPF record validity & DNS lookup budget, DMARC enforcement policy (none/quarantine/reject), BIMI/MTA-STS/TLS-RPT readiness, RDAP domain age & registrar, deliverability grade (A+–F), and actionabl

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: check_disposable_and_role_email · Private data: validate_email, audit_domain_deliverability · Public sink: validate_email, validate_emails_bulk, check_disposable_and_role_email, audit_domain_deliverability · Destructive: audit_domain_deliverability.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: check_disposable_and_role_email · Private data: validate_email, audit_domain_deliverability · Public sink: validate_email, validate_emails_bulk, check_disposable_and_role_email, audit_domain_deliverability · Destructive: audit_domain_deliverability

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
